launch.title: Launch a token
launch.subtitle: Create an ICRC-1 token on the Internet Computer. No presale, no team allocation.
launch.createCtaBody: Name it, fund it, and hand it over in one step.
launch.empty: You have not launched a token yet.
launch.formSubtitle: Everything below is written into the ledger canister and cannot be edited afterwards.
launch.supplyHint: Minted once, to you, at launch. The minting account is then unreachable, so no more can ever be created.
launch.logoTooLarge: That image is too detailed to store on-chain. Try a simpler one.
launch.logoFailed: That file could not be read as an image.
launch.immutableBody: Nobody, including you, can ever change this token's code. The supply is minted once at launch and the minting account is set to the management canister, which nothing can call, so no more can ever be created.
launch.immutableProof: This token has no controller, and its minting account is aaaaa-aa. Call icrc1_minting_account on the ledger to see it yourself — that is what makes the supply fixed, not our word for it.
launch.upgradeableBody: You keep control and can upgrade it later. ICPay will not list it for sending.
launch.insufficient: You need {total} ICP in your wallet to launch.
launch.notReady: Token creation is unavailable right now. No launch can be paid for until it is back.
launch.confirmBody: The fee is charged before the ledger canister is created, and nothing about a launch can be undone.
launch.confirmImmutableWarning: Once launched, this token's code and supply are fixed forever. Check the name, symbol and supply now.
launch.confirmUpgradeableWarning: You will keep control of this token, so ICPay will not list it for sending. Check the name, symbol and supply now.
launch.pendingBody: The ledger canister is being created and funded. This takes a moment and continues even if you leave this page.
launch.failedBody: This launch failed after the fee was charged. Your payment is recorded on the ledger — contact support with the details below.
launch.notFound: This launch could not be found.

bucket.title: ICPay Cloud
bucket.subtitle: Encrypted file storage on-chain
bucket.emptyHint: Create a bucket to store files.
bucket.name: Name
bucket.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens — used in your public CDN URL
bucket.uploadDropHint: Drop files here or tap to browse
bucket.uploadHint: Photos convert to WebP before upload — documents, code, archives, audio, fonts — max {max} per file.
bucket.uploadFailed: Upload failed — try again or use a smaller file
bucket.errInvalidFormat: File rejected — type not supported or content does not match the extension
bucket.errPhotoProcess: Could not process this photo — try JPEG or PNG
bucket.errIngressTooLarge: File exceeds the network limit — it will upload in smaller pieces automatically. Refresh if this persists.
bucket.errStorageLimit: Storage limit reached — delete files or upgrade capacity
bucket.errRateLimit: Too many requests — wait a minute and try again
bucket.errNameTaken: That bucket name is already taken — choose another
bucket.apiAccessNote: Images convert to WebP before upload. Create API keys below for scripts and agents.
bucket.apiKeysHint: Keys are scoped to this bucket. The secret is shown once — copy it when created.
bucket.apiKeyCreatedBody: This secret will not be shown again.
bucket.docsStorageBody: Buckets are paid monthly from your ICPay balance. Files stay encrypted at rest on the canister.
bucket.docsImagesOnly: Images, documents, code, archives, audio, and fonts (see Pricing for the full list).
bucket.docsWebpNote: Native format up to 10 MB. Large files are chunked automatically (IC ingress limit is 2 MiB per call).
bucket.docsEncrypted: Encrypted at rest with per-bucket keys
bucket.docsTiersBody: Prices are fetched live from the canister — cycle cost plus 50% margin, rounded to 0.5 ICP steps.
bucket.pricingSubtitle: Simple, transparent pricing. Pay with ICP — billed every 30 days.
bucket.pricingBreakdownNote: Actual cost is the cycle equivalent for 30 days of reserved capacity. Price includes a 50% margin and is rounded to the nearest 0.5 ICP. Checkout always uses the live canister quote.
bucket.pricingFooter: Files stay on-chain in encrypted form. When a plan expires the bucket becomes read-only until you renew.
bucket.docsCdnBody: Public buckets are served on the IC raw HTTP gateway — bucket name in the path, files at the root (no /uploads/ folder):
bucket.docsCdnPrivate: Private buckets have no public URL — download with downloadFile while signed in.
bucket.docsApiBody: Call these update/query methods on the ICPay backend canister with Internet Identity or a bucket API key:
bucket.docsApiCanister: Canister ID: {id}. Sign in through ICPay or use @dfinity/agent with your Internet Identity delegation.
bucket.docsApiKeysBody: Create keys in the bucket detail page. Pass the secret as the optional last argument on uploadFile and deleteFile.
bucket.docsPaginationBody: Files load {size} per page from the canister to keep queries fast.
